title: Review-Intake & Gate-Hardening
purpose: External reviews keep finding real defects in analyzers declared done. M49 is the standing intake layer: every review claim is verified against code + live parse, fixed with oracle mirror, gated with fixture+mutant+spec in the same session, and the discovered lens is extended family-wide so m37/m14 inherit hardened gates. Cascade: m49 -> m37 -> m14.

issues.notes: Every review folder tracked on the board; method+verdict tally required; resolutions must cite commits; negatives prove prose-only resolutions fail.
